description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller for administrative operations related to user roles within a Learning Management System. It provides endpoints for setting global roles for users, primarily accessible by users with ADMIN role.

classes.name: AdminController
classes.description: REST controller for admin functionalities related to user role management, secured to only allow users with the 'ADMIN' role.

methods.name: AdminController
methods.description: Constructor injecting UserRepository, RoleRepository, and UserRoleRepository.

methods.name: setRole
methods.description: API endpoint to assign a global role to a user, replacing existing roles.
